routes.label: at an office of the Directorate of Nationality, Passports and Immigration

note: The Financial Act FY 2024-2025 (the Ministry of Finance and Planning's scan, Schedule 26(b), Immigration Nationality and Passport, read 2026-11-03 against the page image) has no row for the national identity card: it sets SSP 15,000 for a nationality certificate and SSP 30,000 for a lost nationality or identity certificate. Radio Tamazuj's SSP 30,000 for a nationality card (12 November 2024, the legislature having rejected a proposed rise) matches the lost-certificate row; the Directorate's acting director in Yei told Access Radio (10 July 2026) that a national identity card's processing fee is 'over 50,000' pounds under government regulations. No exact figure for the card itself was found (the FY 2025/26 Act wasn't on the Ministry's site), so the fee is null, as are the card's term, the age and the time.

sources.title: Radio Tamazuj, MPs reject proposed increment of passport, ID fees (12 November 2024)
sources.said: South Sudan currently charges SSP 30,000 for a nationality card, and USD 100 for a regular (ordinary) passport

sources.title: Access Radio (Radio Yei), Yei residents begin collecting nationality cards (10 July 2026)
sources.said: According to Akuai, a South Sudan passport currently costs US$100, while the processing fee for a national identity card is over 50,000 South Sudanese Pounds (SSP), in line with government regulations.
